window: initial RGB through first wheel command, 1.30–12.00 SIM s; GT delayed-timestamp scoring only
preset_selection: Primary if it passes both; otherwise secondary only if it passes both. No fitted parameters or threshold relaxation.
adaptations: Own issued calibrated pulse odometry instead of unavailable wheel encoder odometry; no GT
Static RGB floor-boundary endpoints instead of lidar; unchanged K/D/extrinsic table
Fixed N=2000 retained for coupled latent motion states; ROS CDF multinomial resampling with min=max N, no custom roughening/injection
One camera frame identity: no additional force_update for pan/posture/command token alone
physical_admission: Only after replay reproduces old drift and an unchanged standard preset passes both fixed criteria. One fresh full DEV; freeze ON; pre-register seed and bundle before run.
dev_search_option: CYAN_NOT_UNIQUELY_VISIBLE logs then repeats existing two-view search; never invent a blind target; retain global timeout and physical stops
